The '''Destruction of Sarnus Refinery''' was an assassination attempt organized by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] to force [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to give up his holdings in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]].

==Background==
In [[45 ABY]], the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] were attempting a hostile financial takeover of the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]]. However, their efforts to convince Lando Calrissian to sell his holdings in the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] were unsuccessful. Frustrated, they decided to attempt to kill Calrissian and his allies, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]].

==The skirmish==
The Qrephs used their agent, [[Vestara Khai]], to carry out the assassination, and she infiltrated Calrissian's [[Sarnus Refinery|refinery]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sarnus]]. The refinery was organized to process minerals from an [[asteroid field]] in the rift and had [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] that could pull asteroids from space for [[Mining/Legends|mining]]. Vestara sabotaged one of the tractor beams, causing an asteroid to collide with the refinery, incinerating it and killing thirty thousand of Calrissian's employees.

==Aftermath==
Calrissian and the Solos were able to escape the destruction and they made their way to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valnoos/Legends|Valnoos]], where the Qrephs would organize a [[Firefight at the Blue Star casino|second attempt]] on Calrissian's life.
